slides.headline: Run AI models on your computer
slides.say: Did you know you can now run AI models like DeepSeek and Gemma locally? This is Day 1 of our exclusive 100-day series, finding the best GitHub repo for you.

slides.headline: Run models like DeepSeek locally
slides.body: Download and chat with Kimi, GLM, Qwen, Gemma offline
slides.say: This tool lets you run models like DeepSeek and Gemma right on your own computer, no cloud needed.

slides.headline: Works on Mac, Windows, Linux
slides.body: Docker image plus REST API for Python and JavaScript
slides.say: It runs on Mac, Windows, or Linux, with a Docker option and a simple API for Python or JavaScript.

slides.headline: 182,094 GitHub stars
slides.body: MIT licence · Written in Go · Since June 2023
slides.say: It has over 180 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the MIT licence. It's written in Go and it's been around since June 2023.

slides.headline: Read the licence and README first
slides.body: No warranty; model weights downloaded separately from library
slides.say: Before you start, read the README and licence — there is no warranty, and model files are downloaded separately.

slides.headline: Save · Share · Follow
slides.body: Comment REPO for the full list
slides.say: Loved it? Save this, and send it to a friend. Follow for the next 99 repos... and comment REPO. I'll send you the full list.
